$comment: Settings for the milestone-0 benchmark. Paths are relative to bench/.

wasm.$remoteEndpoint: On-demand TeX Live 2026 package server for anything outside the preloaded bundle (TeXlyre's public one; self-hostable via texlyre-busytex-build). Empty string disables it.

incremental.$comment: Prototype of our own rerun logic: keep generated files, single passes, rerun while any file matching rerunOn changed.
